ALCHEMICAL REVELATIONS
Double Dose0 ACTIONS (1/ENCOUNTER)
When you brew a tier 0 potion double one of its numerical values (e.g. 2×DEX OR 2×INT for Hopping, 2×INT OR two dice for Luck). You cannot double a d20 this way.
Reactive ReagentsPASSIVE
When you roll a on a Catalyst Die, you may immediately reroll it and keep the new result. If the reroll is a , discard the die instead.
Blood Synthesis0 ACTIONS (INT/TURN)
Expend 1 Hit Die to gain 1 Catalyst Die.
Shaped ChargePASSIVE
When you use Multiply It!, you may affect any 4 contiguous spaces instead.
Critical MassPASSIVE
When you crit with any Alchemize, apply one effect to every damaged target depending on the Catalyst Die/Dice you used:
→ Slowed, → Smoldering, → Dazed,
→ Knockback 2, → Poisoned (1 turn), → Prone.
Stable FormulaPASSIVE
At the end of an encounter, you may expend your remaining Catalyst Dice to brew 1 matching Potion. It remains stable until the end of your next encounter.
Altered PhysiquePASSIVE
Gain +4 max Hit Dice.
Combined FormulaPASSIVE
You may expend the corresponding Catalyst Die to add the effect of a tier 0 potion, to any higher tier potion.
Lessons LearntPASSIVE
Whenever you miss with an attack, gain 1 Catalyst Die.
Flash Distillation0 REACTIONS (INT/SAFE REST)
After taking damage, brew a tier 0 or tier 1 potion without expending Catalyst Dice, then immediately drink it or administer it to an ally within Range.
}} {{note,wide,small ***Cloistered Research.*** *You may choose different Alchemist options whenever you do some experiments or research at your laboratory during a Safe Rest.* }} {{pageNumber}} \page {{classSpread}}
